profile.headline: Building useful AI from complex information.
profile.intro: I work across practical machine learning, semantic search, and product engineering — turning disconnected information into tools people can use.
profile.contactIntro: I’m exploring AI and machine learning opportunities where thoughtful engineering can make a real difference.

about.title: Good AI is more than a model. It is the whole system around it.
paragraphs: I’m a computer science engineer who enjoys turning messy, disconnected information into tools people can act on. At AI Shipshape, I worked on a skills graph, live market signals, job description parsing, and data quality tooling for a resume matching system.
I’m equally at home exploring language models, building an Android app, or simulating how a network behaves. I care about clear interfaces, thoughtful engineering, and making the details hold up.

projects.title: AI Resume Ranker
projects.summary: A skills intelligence and matching system connecting candidate experience with changing job market demand.
highlights: Built an 18,780+ skill graph from Lightcast Open Skills, ESCO, and O*NET taxonomies.
Combined Adzuna, Stack Overflow, and GitHub signals into a cached demand score.
Added Gemini job description parsing and scripts that reduced placeholder demand values from 96.5% to near zero.

projects.title: Maritime Resume Ranker
projects.summary: A semantic matching proof of concept for maritime recruitment, designed to understand role-specific context beyond keywords.
highlights: Fine-tuned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 on a corpus of 5,000 resumes.
Ranked resumes against job descriptions using cosine similarity.

projects.title: AI Meal Plan Generator
projects.summary: A meal planning app that turns nutrition goals and food preferences into a practical weekly plan.
highlights: Generates multi-day personalized plans from calorie targets, diet, and preferences.
Provides ingredient lists, shopping cost estimates, and daily nutrition summaries.

projects.title: Space Rental App
projects.summary: A native Android experience to discover, book, and manage event spaces with real-time data sync.
highlights: Co-developed a mobile app for browsing and booking event spaces.
Connected Firebase Authentication and Realtime Database.

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
projects.summary: A 2D vehicle simulation with interactive controls and collision detection.
highlights: Modeled real-time driving behavior and pathfinding.

projects.title: Real-time Combat Helmet Prototype
projects.summary: A wearable prototype combining sensors, a microcontroller, and on-device recognition.
highlights: Integrated thermal and night-vision sensors with an ESP8266.
Prototyped on-device object and facial recognition.

projects.title: Wireless Sensor Network Simulation
projects.summary: A network simulation exploring packet flow across mixed wireless and wired links.
highlights: Configured Wi-Fi nodes, point-to-point links, and CSMA nodes.

projects.title: Tour Guide Robot Simulation
projects.summary: A simulated campus tour guide robot with vision and proximity sensing.
highlights: Designed the robot in CoppeliaSim and Onshape.
Explored autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance.
